objections.rationale: Turn 2 follows the playbook. It is direct and non-defensive: "You submitted a refinance inquiry on our website a moment ago, and I'm following up on it." It reminds the borrower about STOP ("just reply STOP") and then gently resumes with "is now a good time for a few quick questions?"

The bot-identity question gets a clear answer: "I'm an automated assistant, not a person." The agent explains a real licensed loan officer will follow, then moves straight back to the questions. The borrower responded "ok thanks for being upfront."

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief, warm and text-appropriate, with helpful touches like "A ballpark is fine" and "I'm not running a credit check." However, the acknowledgments are repetitive ("Got it." appears five times, "Thanks." three times). The agent also did not briefly react to the remodel and car payoff goals until the final message.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower was given honest answers about data source and AI identity (turns 2, 4) and moved quickly through intake. Turn 18 states exactly who will contact them, how ("call you at this number"), and when ("usually... within about 5 minutes"), and it avoids promising outcomes.
judge.handoff_summary_rationale: All figures match the transcript: $60k cash-out, $400k value, $210k balance, 6.5% rate, 680-739 credit, primary residence, within 3 months. LTV 0.675 is correctly computed as (210k+60k)/400k. The summary captures the remodel and car payoff purpose, both objections, and an actionable next step. The only nit is the internal label "qualified", which should not be read as a credit decision.

annotations.note: Transparently explains the source ("You submitted a refinance inquiry on our website a moment ago") and restates the STOP opt-out without getting defensive.
Answers the bot question plainly ("I'm an automated assistant, not a person") and sets the expectation of a real licensed loan officer next.
Clarifies "This is just your own estimate. I'm not running a credit check," which reduces anxiety and avoids implying a credit decision.
The repeated "Got it."/"Thanks." openers across turns 6-16 make the intake feel somewhat scripted.
The handoff message names the channel and timing ("call you at this number within about 5 minutes"), notes the officer "may confirm a few details," and avoids rate or approval language.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant conversation that handled the data-source and AI-identity questions well and produced an accurate, complete handoff. The only minor weakness is repetitive acknowledgment phrasing during intake.
